messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the RBAC alias migration I found a reproducible case where viewer users see the "Edit project" button in the console. Repro steps below, happened on prod org-231 :eyes:

maria: Repro steps:
```
1) Login as user with role alias: viewer_plus_billing
2) Visit /orgs/org-231/projects/alpha
3) Observe 'Edit project' button shown in header
4) Click -> 403 from API but UI still shows button
```

ajay: Confirmed on org-231, saw the same UX. API denies edit (403) but the UI gate is relying on client-side role mapping. Seems like alias resolution returned the old slug that the frontend treats as editor.

kevin: Could be two separate issues: backend permission decision vs frontend display logic. Any KMS-related logs? I noticed earlier decrypt errors for audit keys, wondering if we missed a migration flag that toggles role aliases.

maria: I dug into the console mapping code — the frontend fetches `/v1/roles?includeAliases=true` and builds a local permission matrix. If an alias name collides with legacy slug names we incorrectly treat it as full role.

leo: I ran an audit-log query for role changes + UI render events, minimal matches but one oddity where alias mapping change happened at 2026-03-20T10:11:23Z right before the first report. Query below (BigQuery):
```sql
SELECT timestamp, user, event_type, details
FROM `redwood-prod.audit_logs`
WHERE org_id = 'org-231'
  AND event_type IN ('role.update','console.render')
  AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(TIMESTAMP('2026-03-20T10:00:00Z'), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AND TIMESTAMP('2026-03-20T10:20:00Z')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

sec-bot: Alert: permission-escalation-suspected on org-231 detected by anomaly-detector v2. Severity: high. Ticket created: SEC-2026-312 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-312) :rotating_light:

ajay: Proposed immediate mitigation: change frontend to rely only on server-provided `can: { project.update: true/false }` flags for gating buttons, not local role slugs. Then roll a patch to hide the button until we normalize aliases. I can open a quick PR for the patch. :shipit:

kevin: +1. Also we should add an audit log entry when alias->slug resolution occurs so we can trace future regressions. If KMS plays a role (key access for role metadata), we need to check KMS permission logs — seems unrelated but worth verifying.

maria: I'll own triage. Action items:
- maria: reproduce in canary, confirm API denies while UI shows (in progress)
- ajay: small frontend patch to gate on server can: flags and hide button (hotfix)
- kevin: check KMS audit (decrypt attempts) and role metadata fetch traces
- leo: expand audit query to cross-check role_alias table migration events

ajay: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4399 — hides edit button and falls back to server `can` map. Will request prod hotfix review.

maria: If we push hotfix, we should also add a short-lived telemetry metric to count mismatches between UI gate and API result. Example: `ui_gate_mismatch{org}`. Useful for rollback if noise increases.

kevin: Forensics update: KMS logs show two failed decrypts for audit-key in window 10:10:50-10:11:10Z from service-account svc-console-migrator. They succeeded later. Not seeing evidence that KMS caused wrong role mapping, but note the migrator ran at the same time.

leo: Found migration job log snippet (internal S3):
```
INFO 2026-03-20T10:11:22Z roles-migration: applying alias normalization for tenant org-231
WARN 2026-03-20T10:11:23Z roles-migration: alias 'viewer_plus_billing' maps to legacy 'editor' slug, preserving legacy_slug field
```

maria: That WARN is the smoking gun — the migration preserved legacy_slug and frontend interpreted it as canonical. Quick fix: change migration to clear legacy_slug OR update API to not expose legacy_slug to public `roles` endpoint.

ajay: Hotfix PR updated to also ignore legacy_slug on client: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4401 (patch). Planning deploy to canary in 15m. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Deploy pipeline note: canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-20T10:40Z by ajay. Monitoring dashboards pinned: console-ui-errors, ui_gate_mismatch.

kevin: Post-deploy checks we need:
- run audit query for `ui_gate_mismatch` metric over orgs for last 24h
- sample affected orgs to confirm UI hides button
- confirm no increase in 403s for legitimate editors (false-deny risk)

maria: I'll coordinate a brief postmortem once hotfix is stable. Short notes to include in SEC-2026-312: root cause = migration preserved legacy_slug causing frontend misinterpretation; mitigations = hotfix + migration cleanup + telemetry + stricter API contract for roles.

leo: One more ask — add a CI test to prevent frontend from rendering edit controls unless server `can` map has the permission. Small unit test will prevent regressions.

ajay: Agreed, adding tests to PR. ETA for full rollout (if canary clean) 2 hours.

maria: Thanks everyone. Ping me in thread if you spot other orgs with similar drift. :eyes:
